Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Prior lateral release and possible plica resection, limited mobility.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Trace joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage heterogeneity and fissuring along the medial femoral condyle near the intercondylar notch. No focal full-thickness defect.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Heterogeneity and high-grade fissuring at the median ridge in the central trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt. Mild lateral patellar translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Mild medial and patellofemoral compartmental chondrosis.

2. Anatomic features predisposing to lateral patellofemoral maltracking.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Légère arthrose du compartiment fémoro-patellaire avec de petits ostéophytes marginaux, il y a une chondropatie associée avec des zones de chondropathie de grade 3-4 avec une fissuration profonde au niveau des facettes médiales et latérales et de la trochlée latérale, un petit foyer d'œdème réactionnel de la moelle osseuse au niveau de la facette patellaire médiale.
Chondropathie légère à modérée des compartiments médial et latéral avec chondropathie de grade 3 et fissuration profonde de la face portante des condyles fémoraux, davantage du côté médial.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Par ailleurs normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : normal.

Ménisque médial : Changements dégénératifs du signal du corps méniscal médial et de la corne postérieure sans déchirure méniscale évidente.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normal.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normal.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-latéral et postérieur : Normal.

Épanchement articulaire : Épanchement articulaire petit à modéré.
Kyste de Baker : Kyste de Baker de taille modérée, sans signe de rupture. Il y a une souris articulaire chondrale à l'intérieur du kyste de Baker mesurant jusqu'à 6 mm.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Aucune.

CONCLUSION :
Changements dégénératifs tricompartimentaux tels que décrits avec chondropatie pire dans les compartiments médial et fémoropatellaire et zones de fissuration/perte profonde du cartilage telles que décrites.
Épanchement articulaire petit à modéré et kyste de Baker modéré, le kyste de Baker contenant une souris articulaire chondrale mesurant 6 mm.
Changements dégénératifs du signal du ménisque médial sans déchirure.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Background chronic intermittent pain. New onset of increased pain after jumping
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.2 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Medial tibial plateau edema secondary to meniscal pathology. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of body and posterior horn, with mild extrusion of the body. Small fragment partially displaced into the medial meniscotibial recess.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild chondrosis with signal alteration in the medial patellar facet

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 18 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Fatty atrophy of the semimembranosus and semitendinosus muscles. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion of the body and partially displaced small fragment into the medial meniscotibial recess.
2.	Mild patellofemoral chondrosis.
